note: Expected records.RosArgs per case in tests/fixtures/ws_static/argv/argv_cases.json. Absent keys mean the dataclass default: null for node_name, namespace, log_level and enclave, and an empty tuple for params_files, assignments, remaps and leftover.
conventions: Tokens outside any --ros-args block: a bare __node:=X or __name:=X sets node_name, __ns:=X sets namespace, any other a:=b becomes a remap, everything else appends to leftover in encounter order.
Inside a block: -p and --param take NAME:=VALUE, -r and --remap take FROM:=TO, --params-file takes a path, --log-level and --enclave take a value, and a bare -- closes the block.
A recognised flag whose value is missing, or whose value lacks the := an assignment needs, contributes the flag token and any value token it consumed to leftover, in encounter order. It never raises.
An assignment or a remap with an empty left hand side is malformed and goes to leftover the same way. An empty right hand side is legal and yields an empty string value.
Any token inside a block that is not a recognised flag goes to leftover.
Values keep their raw spelling: no typing, no case folding, no path normalising.
Order is preserved in every tuple and duplicates are kept. Last wins is a consumer decision, not a parser one.
